async function reproduce() {$
  console.log('Test: Signal abort while task is queued should REMOVE it from queue');$

    console.log('Second task started');$
    return 'done';$
  }, { signal: controller.signal });$

  // Abort while task is still queued$
  controller.abort();$
$

  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));$
$
  // Check queue state after abort$
  console.log('Queue size after abort:', queue.size);$
  console.log('Pending after abort:', queue.pending);$
